Dear [Recipient's Name],  

I’ve known Kiran Thapa for nearly three years through our cross-functional projects at AdVelox Technologies. As a peer, I’ve collaborated with him on several adtech initiatives, including scaling our real-time bidding platform and optimizing campaign performance dashboards. Our interactions are occasional but meaningful, often centered around solving complex technical challenges and refining workflows.  

Kiran’s strength lies in his ability to architect scalable microservices that balance flexibility and performance. For instance, he led the redesign of our campaign analytics module into a microservices-based system, reducing latency by 35% and enabling faster iteration cycles. His attention to detail ensures systems are robust, and his collaborative mindset fosters knowledge sharing within teams. Beyond technical skills, Kiran consistently prioritizes reliability—whether debugging production issues under pressure or mentoring junior developers through code reviews.  

One standout example was during a high-stakes client onboarding. Kiran spearheaded the integration of a third-party ad verification tool, coordinating with external vendors and internal stakeholders to meet a tight deadline. His proactive communication and technical acumen ensured the project delivered 20% faster results than projected, earning praise from both the client and our leadership.  

In summary, Kiran is a dependable, results-driven engineer with a knack for turning complex problems into streamlined solutions. His work ethic and technical depth make him a valuable asset to any team.  

Please feel free to reach out if you need further details.  

Sincerely,
